calibration_sources: WebArena & OSWorld Multimodal GUI/Browser Agent Benchmarks (DOM vs AXTree vs Vision SoM Ablations)
Set-of-Marks (SoM) Visual Prompting & Browser-Use / Playwright CDP Accessibility Tree Extraction
API-First Hybrid Web Agents (Beyond Browsing: Combining API Interception with GUI Fallback)

workload.automation_scenario: 10-Step Enterprise SaaS & Legacy ERP Workflow (Login/SSO -> Filter Data Table -> Export & Cross-Fill Form across Salesforce/SAP/Workday)
workload.benchmark_profile: 1,000 Multi-Step WebArena / OSWorld Enterprise Workflows (82,000 raw HTML tokens per page)
workload.core_bottlenecks: Raw HTML token explosion, VLM raw (x,y) pixel regression errors on dense tables, and slow multi-page UI pagination

tiers.name: Tier 1: 原始全量 HTML DOM 树硬塞 (每步 82K 词 -> 10步烧 82万词 + Shadow DOM/Canvas 失明)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Raw Full HTML DOM Dumping (820K Tokens/Task & 41.2% Success Rate)
tiers.observation_and_grounding_stack: Dumps raw page.content() HTML (nested divs, Tailwind classes, SVGs = 82K tok/step) into LLM
tiers.execution_and_session_model: Cold headless browser boot per run + CSS/XPath selector generation
tiers.recommended_for: Static 1990s HTML pages (<5KB) only; unusable on modern React/SPA enterprise web apps.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 纯视觉截图绝对像素坐标回归 (Pure Vision (x,y) -> 密集表格点歪率 18.4% + 耗时 34.5s)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Pure Vision Screenshot (x, y) Pixel-Coordinate Grounding (58.6% Success)
tiers.observation_and_grounding_stack: 1920x1080 raw screenshot per step; VLM directly regresses (x=1428, y=392) pixel coordinates
tiers.execution_and_session_model: Works on any OS/Canvas UI, but suffers 18.4% off-by-15px mis-clicks on small icons & dense table rows
tiers.recommended_for: Remote desktop / Citrix / native legacy Windows GUI apps where zero DOM or Accessibility Tree exists.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 精简无障碍树 (AXTree) + Set-of-Marks (SoM) 视觉编号框对齐 (Browser-Use / SeeAct 范式)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Pruned Accessibility Tree (AXTree) + Set-of-Marks (SoM) ID Grounding (78.4% Success)
tiers.observation_and_grounding_stack: CDP Accessibility Tree + interactive DOM filter + numbered [1..N] bounding-box overlay on screenshot
tiers.execution_and_session_model: LLM outputs click(id=14) instead of guessing (x,y) pixels -> cuts grounding error to 3.2%
tiers.recommended_for: General-purpose browser automation across unfamiliar third-party websites.

tiers.name: Tier 4: CDP 网络 API 自动逆向旁路 + AXTree/SoM 视觉兜底 + 预认证持久会话池 (Enterprise CUA 标杆)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Hybrid CDP Network/API Bypass + AXTree/SoM Fallback + Pre-Warmed Session Pool
tiers.observation_and_grounding_stack: Intercepts internal REST/GraphQL calls via CDP for data/table ops + AXTree/SoM only for visual UI steps
tiers.execution_and_session_model: Pre-authenticated warm browser context pool (0s SSO login) + replays captured fetch() APIs in 150ms
tiers.recommended_for: Production enterprise RPA replacement, high-frequency SaaS/ERP automation, and low-latency Browser Agents (91.8% success).
